name: swiss-passport-zh
description: MCP server for learning the Zurich naturalisation knowledge test

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/http.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/http.js --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/vercel.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=api/mcp.js --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node scripts/copy-data.mjs && node scripts/build-view.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && mcpb pack . swiss-passport-zh.mcpb
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/http-test.mjs
scripts.release: npm run build && rm -rf release && mkdir -p release/swiss-passport-server && cp -R dist data deploy/install.sh deploy/uninstall.sh release/swiss-passport-server/ && tar -czf release/swiss-passport-server.tgz -C release swiss-passport-server && rm -rf release/swiss-passport-server
